theorem lg_target : StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) fun x => √x := by
  intros a b h ab
  have h1 : 0 ≤ a := Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 (Set.Ici.mem_Ici a)
  have h2 : 0 ≤ b := Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 (Set.Ici.mem_Ici b)
  have h3 : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 := or.intro_left _ (ne.symm h ab)
  let c := max a b
  have h4 : c ≥ a := max_le_left a b
  have h5 : c ≥ b := max_le_right a b
  have h6 : 0 ≤ c := max_le_zero h1 h2
  have h7 : √c - √a ≤ (√c - √b) * (c - a) / (c - b) :=
    calc
      √c - √a = (√c - √b) + (√b - √a) := by rw [sub_add]
      _ ≤ (√c - √b) + (√b - √a) * (c - a) / (c - b) :=
        add_le_add_right (le_mul_div (le_refl (√c - √b)) (le_refl (c - a)) (le_refl (c - b)))
          (le_div_iff (le_refl (c - b)) (le_refl (c - a))).mpr (le_rfl (c - a)))
      _ = (√c - √b) + (√b - √a) * (c - a) / (c - b) :=
        by rw [sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg]
      _ ≤ (√c - √b) + (√b - √a) * (c - a) / (c - b) :=
        add_le_add_right (le_mul_div (le_refl (√c - √b)) (le_refl (c - a)) (le_refl (c - b)))
